scope: complete bounded product-source callee inventory for the frozen pure encoder and encoding bridges/getters/helpers; source-storage accounting only

closures.not_an_extra_sum_term: all materialized expression/argument/local roles are already charged in roles; zero-sized expression occurrences remain in closure-occurrences.json

multiplicity: Every unique (function source identity, MIR local) occurs once; loops and repeated calls reuse source templates; disjoint branches and all distinct local/return/move intermediates are conservatively summed. A move operation is linked to its original slot and destination; it is not charged again as an invented copy.
ownership: Only encoder/bridge/getter/helper callee parameter, return-expression, named-local/pattern and compiler-projected source temporary slots. External owner/payload/caller slots excluded by partition.json.
